info.title: nettriage 0.2.2 — deterministic .NET modernization triage
info.description: Deterministic, offline triage for .NET Framework to modern .NET migrations. Finds WebForms, server-side WCF, .NET Remoting, AppDomain, Workflow Foundation, BinaryFormatter, EF6 and other porting blockers across an entire solution or estate, then sequences the work.
